newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Stock Exchange changes its name.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Stock Exchange changes its name.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange said Monday it changed its name to the Pacific Exchange (PCX).

"We wanted to make a bold statement that we're not just a stock exchange -- we're also a strong force in options trading," Tom Heebner, vice chairman of the exchange's Options Marketing Committee, said in a statement.
The exchange had been known as the Pacific Stock Exchange since 1972. Before that it was the Pacific Coast Stock Exchange. ((-Derivatives desk,3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
